title: Treesa-Gayatri Face Top Seeds Liu-Tan in BWF Worlds Semis
indian_angle: India's women's doubles pair is on the cusp of a historic BWF World Championships final.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are set to challenge world No. 1 Liu Sheng Shu and Tan Ning in the BWF World Championships semifinal, aiming to repeat a past upset despite a 6-1 head-to-head deficit.

title: Treesa-Gayatri Secure India's First Women's Doubles World Championships Medal
indian_angle: The unseeded Indian duo ended a 15-year wait for a women's doubles medal at the BWF World Championships.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand created history by stunning fourth seeds Jia and Zhang 16-21, 21-15, 21-13 in the BWF World Championships quarter-finals, guaranteeing India a medal.

title: Satwik-Chirag Exit BWF World Championships in Quarter-Finals
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair faced a tough challenge and bowed out of the BWF World Championships.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty lost to China's Chang and Liang 21-18, 21-9 in the BWF World Championships quarter-finals, ending their campaign amid fitness concerns.

title: BAI Successfully Hosts BWF World Championships After 17 Years
indian_angle: Badminton Association of India showcased its improved capabilities by hosting a major BWF event after a long hiatus.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully organized the BWF World Championships in India for the first time in 17 years, implementing lessons learned from the India Open to enhance facilities and operations.

title: Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Exit at BWF World Championships
indian_angle: India's promising men's singles player Lakshya Sen was unexpectedly defeated by an American teenager.
summary: India's Lakshya Sen was eliminated from the BWF World Championships after a challenging match against American teenager Garret Tan, marking a surprise early exit.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for upcoming international junior championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian junior badminton team is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare players for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.
